ينتحب (form VIII)
# يَنْتَحِبُ (yantaḥibu) /jan.ta.ħi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
# يَنْتَحِبَ (yantaḥiba) /jan.ta.ħi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
# يَنْتَحِبْ (yantaḥib) /jan.ta.ħib/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
